raw:
Professor Stone looks at the open book, then gives a small, humorless smile.

“At this Academy, perhaps. Elsewhere, we’re less decorative than people suppose.”

He crosses to the shelf and draws out a thinner volume bound in worn brown cloth. Its title is stamped in fading gilt: *Records of the Human Seat, 211–Present*.

“This is mine. The reading list is inside the cover.” He sets it beside your textbook but keeps two fingers on it a moment longer. “Have the lawyers told you anything useful about your family beyond the word inheritance?”
